name: Zorpians
note: 4,000 hand-drawn Greys, each carrying a real company. Minting on OpenSea, Robinhood Chain. The project needs an X username for every winner — file your comment link in #mint-proof or the spot cannot be passed on.

name: Toadstools
note: 419 free Ordinals on Bitcoin, minting on Ord Dropz. Blind mint — you do not see which Toadstool you got until it lands, and nobody can snipe it out of the mempool. Every piece sits on a block-9443 Nakamoto sat and every inscription ID ends 70ad. Allowlist is a six-hour window from launch with all 419 reserved, one per wallet. Delivery needs the taproot address (bc1p…) you submitted — a bc1q segwit address cannot hold an inscription.

name: Hood Wolves
note: The Ape Cubz evolution by Deebs. Robinhood Chain, launching through Unvault — no date announced yet. Holding 2 Ape Cubz is a guaranteed wolf on their own terms, separate from the spot you hold here.

name: Pawffle
note: Cute felines touching grass. 3,333, Robinhood Chain. No date announced yet; they also hand out GTD spots to holders of eligible collections at pawffles.xyz.

name: W3BFR0G
note: 9,999 hand-drawn frogs on Ethereum. OG is free and capped at 1 per wallet; the first-come window is 0.0022 ETH and up to 10. Windows read off their mint contract on OpenSea.

name: Pharaoh God Mob
note: 10K generative Gods on Robinhood Chain, built from 179 attributes. A FREE mint, whitelist only — their Godlist is guaranteed and their Moblist is first-come. No date announced yet.

name: The Furnace
note: 3,232 pixel furnaces on Robinhood Chain. Each mint activates an ERC-6551 token-bound wallet tied to the NFT — sell the Furnace and the wallet and everything in it goes with it. Mint price and date not announced yet.

name: Astral Sentinels
note: 4,444 code-drawn guardians on OpenSea. GTD and FCFS mint at 0.001 ETH, public at 0.0016. Check your phase on their own checker at astralsentinels.fun/whitelist.
